plan.coverage_notes: This plan targets a practicing cardiologist/electrophysiologist who manages AFib across the full spectrum of care. It covers the five core treatment domains — catheter ablation (techniques, outcomes, technology), anticoagulation (DOAC selection, bleeding risk, stroke risk scores), rhythm vs rate control strategy, LAAC device therapy, and landmark trials/guidelines — through 17 queries designed to retrieve clinically actionable papers. The plan deliberately excludes basic electrophysiology, AFib genetics, and health economics research unless directly linked to a named clinical decision, consistent with the reader's focus on bottom-line clinical takeaways. Queries use named drug names, device names, trial acronyms, and scoring systems as specificity carriers to ensure precision while allowing broad recall within each clinical subdomain.
